biomarker_name.evidence_quote: Among the ten human proteins with the greatest changes in abundance in the faeces of individuals with T1DM...α-amylase proteins AMY2A and AMY2B...lactotransferrin (LTF) and the lactotransferrin receptor intelectin (ITLN1)...Differential transcript abundances of diverse functions suggested differences in the availability or microbial use of cellulose and subtle differences in the immune status (genes for reactive oxygen species (ROS) detoxi­fication, cell surface proteins and complement-inactivating staphopain A)
biomarker_name.section: Results — Human protein excretion in T1DM and microbial functions
biomarker_name.notes: Multiple biomarkers identified as having altered abundance in T1DM individuals compared to healthy relatives

biomarker_unit.evidence_quote: Relative protein abundances of human AMY2A and AMY2B...24 with P < 0.05 after FDR adjustment; |Spearman's ρ| > 0.75
biomarker_unit.section: Results — Human protein excretion in T1DM and microbial functions; Methods — Integrated data handling
biomarker_unit.notes: Units vary by biomarker type: proteins measured as relative abundance; transcripts as normalized reads; correlations as Spearman's ρ

biomarker_value.evidence_quote: we found four proteins...to be less abundant in the stool of individuals with T1DM...lactotransferrin (LTF) and the lactotransferrin receptor intelectin (ITLN1), to be...higher abundance in the individuals with T1DM...24 with P < 0.05 after FDR adjustment
